text: Gold rose to about $4,114 by 7:30 AM ET and silver to about $52.76, both up roughly 1.5% from Friday's close, after gold touched about $4,135 overnight.
Barrick reported third-quarter adjusted earnings of $0.82 a share on revenue of $5.07 billion, up 22%, and kept its full-year output guidance. GDX was about 2.6% higher before the open.
Nvidia fell about 5% before the open after its board opened a review of CEO Jensen Huang's ties to a businesswoman US agencies say is a Chinese spy, holding back Nasdaq futures.
Stock futures were higher overall: S&P 500 futures up about 0.5% and Dow futures about 0.9% at 6:08 AM ET, while Nasdaq futures were barely positive.
The 10-year Treasury yield held near 4.86% and the 2-year near 4.52% as traders waited for Tuesday's October inflation report.
Brent slipped to about $97.65 after last week's roughly 16% fall, as President Trump signaled no new strikes on Iran while talks progress.
Bitcoin fell to about $74,500, briefly touching $73,510, as more than $1 billion of leveraged bets were wiped out and bitcoin ETFs saw $1.28 billion of outflows last week.
